$comment: Paintings used on the site. To swap one: replace its master in art-src/ (or run `npm run art -- <id>=/path/to/new.png`), adjust the focal points below, then commit the regenerated renditions. `position` is the CSS object-position on wide screens, `positionMobile` on screens up to 760px wide, `side` is where the subject sits (the headline goes on the other side), `tone` is `dark` for a painting that needs light text over it.
